help.title: Help and How to Use
help.intro: RentMeezy helps owners of residential and commercial places bill and collect rent, and helps renters see and pay what they owe. Tap a topic to learn more.
help.b_start: Owners: sign in with your mobile number, fill in your owner details (name as on PAN, PAN, address and a property document), choose a plan, then add your places (residential or commercial) and renters. Renters: sign in with the mobile number your owner used. You will see your rentals as soon as an owner invites you. Renters never pay for RentMeezy. New owners choose a plan on the first screen and then sign in. Already registered? Use I'm an owner, already registered, or I'm a renter, sign in. To use another number, tap Sign in with a different number.
help.b_bills: Every month RentMeezy creates one bill for each tenancy: rent plus any charges such as electricity, water or maintenance. The bill shows each line, what is paid, and the total due, so owners and renters always see the same numbers. Owners approve any extra charge before it appears on a bill.
help.b_pay: Renters can pay online from the bill. Owners can also record cash or other payments they receive in person. Both appear in the same payment history, are matched to the bill, and update the balance at once. Each payment has a receipt.
help.b_remind: RentMeezy sends reminders to renters before the due date, on the due day and when a bill is overdue. Owners are also reminded about pending approvals and payments. Reminders stop once a bill is fully paid and continue for any balance still unpaid. Reminders go only to verified contacts, within quiet hours. An owner reviews and approves AI-written messages before they are sent.
help.b_pricing: Owners pay a monthly plan. Starter ₹10: up to 10 places, 1 property, no AI. Growth ₹50: up to 100 places, 5 properties, AI voice and text with 1 lakh tokens. Business ₹100: up to 250 places, 10 properties, 5 lakh tokens. Max ₹1,000: up to 1,000 places, 100 properties, 10 lakh tokens. The launch price is what you pay; the crossed-out regular price and the Save percentage show what the plan usually costs. The Plans screen always shows the current numbers. Change your plan any time from your profile or Plans and Pricing. Renters always use RentMeezy free.
help.b_verify: To protect everyone, owners verify their details and identity before collecting real rent. RentMeezy keeps only the result of the identity check, not your ID numbers, photos or selfies. A renter sees a Verified badge on each owner.
help.b_roles: You can use RentMeezy as an owner, a renter or both. The bar at the top shows which one you are viewing. Tap Switch To at the top right to change. A renter with several owners sees each owner's rentals grouped in their own colour.
help.b_ai: On higher plans, ask the AI assistant questions such as how much is pending this month, and let it draft reminders for you to approve. To add many renters at once, use Import Excel under Add Renter.
help.b_more: If something looks wrong, pull down to refresh or check your internet connection. The screen explains any problem in plain words.
help.b_places: When you add a renter, choose Residential or Commercial. Pick the floor (ground to 10th) and name the place anything you like, such as D-05, 2 shops or Hostel 10-50. Different places in one building can have different renters, but one place on one floor has only one renter at a time. A place that already has a renter is locked until that renter leaves. Write what you provide with the place (fan, cupboard, parking) in Items Provided. On Home, Collected, Pending and Overdue show the renters behind each number; use Collection there to record a payment.
help.b_vacate: Owners: open a renter and choose Vacate. Enter the date they left and, if you keep part of the deposit, a note saying why. The renter sees the note too. The place then shows as vacant and can go to a new renter. Renters: you cannot close a rental yourself. Choose the place in Profile, Close Account (or on the rental) and send a request to that place's owner. Only that owner is told, and the rental ends when they approve. You can take the request back before it is answered.
help.b_relief: If you cannot pay the whole rent this month, open the bill and tap Ask to pay less. Say how much you can pay now. The owner can agree, change the amount or decline. If agreed, the bill shows the full month, the amount to pay now and the rest moved to next month, for both of you. Owners can also grant this from the renter's bill without being asked.
help.b_agree: Each renter has an agreement end date. 30 days before it ends, the owner and the renter get an alert in the bell, and it stays until the date is moved. The owner can extend the agreement or start a new one; earlier agreements stay in the history. A yearly rent increase (in percent) is shown on the agreement.
help.b_notify: The bell at the top shows news for the role you are using. Owners see requests (paying less, vacating), plan reminders and agreement alerts. Renters see changes to rent, advance or cash received, answers to their requests, messages from the owner and agreement alerts. A number shows what is new. Requests leave the bell once they are answered.
help.b_message: Owners: open Message Renter. Speak or type your message and choose the language it should be delivered in. Send it to the renter's bell, by SMS or by WhatsApp. The renter also sees it in their own notifications.
help.b_download: Owners: from the Collected, Pending, Overdue and places lists, and from a renter's statement, download an Excel or PDF file. Renters: download your own statement, or a report of all your rentals, as Excel or PDF. Everyone: Profile, Download My Data gives a CSV or PDF copy of the details RentMeezy holds about you. Files open in the share sheet so you can save or send them.
help.b_account: In Profile you can change your name, address, language and mobile number, add a second mobile or email, and choose which messages come by SMS, WhatsApp or email. You can pick English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi or Bengali on the first screen, in the menu or in Profile. An owner who closes their account is first asked to transfer all places and renters to another mobile number; the new owner must pay for a plan before using them. A renter with a rental must ask each owner to vacate before closing their account.
help.b_upi: For each tenant you choose how you receive rent: UPI (free), online checkout, or cash or bank transfer. With UPI, the tenant sees your UPI ID, opens Google Pay or another UPI app with the amount filled in, pays you directly and enters the UPI reference number in the app. You then check your bank or UPI app and tap Received. Only then do the tenant's dues reduce and a receipt is created. If you did not receive it, tap Not Received. A new UPI ID needs a code sent to your mobile, and your tenant is told if you change how they pay. Tenants: check that your UPI app shows the owner's name before you pay.

privacy.title: Privacy and Your Data
privacy.closeWarn: Closing your account removes your name, address, mobile numbers, email and PAN, and signs you out everywhere. Bills, payments and receipts must be kept for accounting and stay in the other person's records without your details. You cannot close the account while you have an active rental.
privacy.collect: What we collect: your name, address, mobile number, email, owner PAN and property proof, and your rent, bill and payment records.
privacy.use: How we use it: to create bills, collect and record rent, send reminders you allow, and keep your account safe. We do not sell your data.
privacy.share: Who sees it: an owner and their renter see each other's name, mobile number and rent details for that rental only. Payment partners see only what is needed to take a payment.
privacy.keep: How long we keep it: bills, payments and receipts are kept as accounting records. Your PAN is stored encrypted and shown only in masked form.
privacy.rights: Your rights: you can see and correct your details in Profile, download a copy of your data, and close your account at any time.
